news.title: Alaska summer salmon season opens with high-value Copper River harvest
news.summary: While dwarfed by the much larger Bristol Bay sockeye runs, the Copper River harvest is much earlier and heralds the opening of Alaska's summer wild salmon season

news.title: UCN proposes launch of new US wholesale price reporting for salmon roe
news.summary: This proposed launch reflects increasing interest in benchmark pricing for Alaska salmon roe amid evolving global supply dynamics, fluctuating Japanese demand trends and broader volatility across salmon commodity markets
